entries.18ca5a907e357165: The core customers are consumers who shop at stores and online stores in each region. The other main customer group consists of the business partners that operate license stores that exclusively sell “Muji” and “ＭＵＪＩ.” Using this scheme, the company concluded a license agreement with Al Shaya Trading in January 2013 and opened its first Muji store in the Middle East. entries.402ecd54c7a7bb08: RYOHIN KEIKAKU CO., LTD. is the parent company of a group consisting of the company and 28 subsidiaries, and is an operating company that itself also sells and supplies products in Japan, sells food and beverages, and operates campgrounds. Established in June 1989 through a spin-off, with the aim of establishing the business foundation and expanding the scale of “Muji,” which had been developed and sold in 1980 as a private brand of Seiyu Store Co., Ltd. (now Seiyu Co., Ltd.). Overseas, local subsidiaries in each region handle sales: East Asia is covered by MUJI (HONG KONG) CO.,LTD., Mujirushi Ryohin (Shanghai) Commercial Co., Ltd., Taiwan Mujirushi Ryohin Co., Ltd. and MUJI Korea Co.,Ltd., and Europe and the Americas are covered by MUJI Europe Limited and its subsidiaries. In Japan, MUJI HOUSE Co., Ltd. handles housing sales. In the current consolidated fiscal year, it established MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING (CAMBODIA) CO.,LTD. and MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED and included them in consolidation, and it excluded MUJI Global Sourcing Private Limited from consolidation as that company began liquidation proceedings.

entries.76e10bcace9a9d21: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in Europe and the Americas. MUJI Europe Limited handles supply, RYOHIN KEIKAKU EUROPE LTD., RYOHIN KEIKAKU FRANCE S.A.S., MUJI ITALIA S.p.A., MUJI Deutschland GmbH, MUJI SPAIN, S.L., MUJI PORTUGAL,LDA, MUJI U.S.A. Limited and MUJI CANADA LIMITED handle sales, and MUJI Finland Oy handles sales and food and beverage sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥42,133 million (up 7.9% year on year), and segment profit was ¥6,922 million (up 25.7%). The company explains that the number of stores fell year on year due to closures of unprofitable stores, while same-store sales grew, and cites that in Europe, profitability improved as unprofitable stores were closed under the structural reforms accompanying the previous year's business restructuring, and that in North America, expanded in-store inventory contributed to same-store sales growth, and closures of unprofitable stores in Canada also contributed to profit improvement. The segment has 558 employees (in addition, an annual average of 475 temporary employees).

entries.94d40e951cfaa6f2: Although the products it handles are wide-ranging, including apparel and goods, household goods and food, all are products of its own brands “Muji” and “ＭＵＪＩ,” and the company handles everything from product planning and development to product procurement and distribution processing in-house. The company defines its corporate philosophy as contributing to “a pleasant way of living and society” through products, services, stores and activities that consider “a desirable relationship between people, nature and things and a rich human society,” and it sets its first mission as “developing basic everyday products with honest quality and an ethical perspective, and offering products that make society better through use, at prices that are easy to pick up,” and its second mission as “stores that serve as community centers in each region, sharing issues and values with local residents, working together on local issues and realizing positive impact for the region.” Product research and quality control are handled by the global sourcing companies in China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia and India.
entries.95a439bfe0cdc031: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, which the company describes as the Global Sourcing Business. Aimujisi (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED, PT. MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDONESIA, MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING (CAMBODIA) CO.,LTD. and MUJI GLOBAL SOURCING INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED conduct research and quality control for MUJI products. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, there was no operating revenue from external customers; revenue consisted of intersegment internal operating revenue of ¥1,401 million. Segment profit was ¥73 million, and the segment had 107 employees. This segment supports the product-making side within the group and is not a segment that sells to outside consumers.
entries.9c4ff77f3a5e71f4: The Group consists of the company and 28 subsidiaries, and its main business is the sale of its own-brand products “Muji” and “ＭＵＪＩ.” It handles product planning and development, product procurement, distribution processing and retail through its directly operated stores in-house, and it also supplies products to business partners that operate license stores that exclusively sell “Muji” and “ＭＵＪＩ.” In other words, there are two routes for revenue: sales to consumers through its own directly operated stores and online store, and supply of products to business partners that operate license stores. In addition, it sells food and beverages under the “Café&Meal MUJI” brand, operates campgrounds, sells housing, and sells products under the “IDÉE” brand. Reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are divided by region into four: “Domestic Business,” “East Asia Business,” “Southeast Asia & Oceania Business” and “Europe and Americas Business,” and a global sourcing business that is not included in reportable segments is added. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, there is no single external customer accounting for 10% or more of operating revenue.
entries.a5b7c05036263505: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in East Asia. MUJI (HONG KONG) CO.,LTD., MUJI (Shanghai) Commercial Co., Ltd. and Taiwan MUJI Co., Ltd. handle sales and food and beverage sales, and MUJI Korea Co.,Ltd. handles sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥222,247 million (up 14.2% year on year), and segment profit was ¥42,794 million (up 20.4%), the second-largest scale after the domestic business. The company cites online sales growth in mainland China, driven by active promotional activities, with daily goods and food leading strong sales, and gross profit improvement from lower cost ratios and restrained price cuts as contributing factors. Taiwan and Hong Kong also posted higher revenue and profit, while Korea recorded higher revenue as same-store sales grew, but profit declined due to the impact of exchange rates. The segment has 6,594 employees (in addition, an annual average of 2,634 temporary employees), the largest of the reportable segments.
entries.b1e9688189c37ff6: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥784,629 million (up 18.6% year on year), and the company states that operating revenue and every stage of profit were all record highs. The breakdown is merchandise and product sales of ¥779,864 million and operating income of ¥4,764 million. By product, household goods were ¥368,184 million (up 21.6% year on year), apparel and goods ¥285,294 million (up 14.7%), food ¥104,655 million (up 21.6%) and other ¥26,495 million (up 10.3%). By segment, external operating revenue was Domestic Business ¥470,143 million, East Asia Business ¥222,247 million, Southeast Asia & Oceania Business ¥50,105 million and Europe and Americas Business ¥42,133 million.
entries.b79dfba4d10e21df: This is an operating segment not included in the reportable segments, which the company describes as the Global Sourcing Business.
entries.bfbb79f937420adb: Gross operating profit for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥402,975 million, and its ratio to operating revenue was 51.4% (up 0.5 percentage points from the previous year). Selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥329,135 million, with a ratio to operating revenue of 42.0% (down 0.4 percentage points), and operating profit was ¥73,840 million (up 31.5% year on year), a ratio of 9.4%. Ordinary profit was ¥72,301 million (up 29.6%), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥50,846 million (up 22.3%). Segment profit (based on operating profit) was Domestic Business ¥52,111 million, East Asia Business ¥42,794 million, Europe and Americas Business ¥6,922 million, Southeast Asia & Oceania Business ¥5,584 million and other ¥73 million, totaling ¥107,412 million, from which an adjustment of ¥33,645 million for company-wide expenses and other items not allocated to each reportable segment is deducted. Although the East Asia Business's operating revenue is less than half that of the Domestic Business, its segment profit is close to that of the Domestic Business.
entries.c07cb41c9f49d986: The core of the domestic business, selling 'MUJI' and 'ＭＵＪＩ' products through directly operated stores in Japan and the online shop 'MUJI Net Store', launched in September 2000. Directly operated stores are located in each region from Hokkaido to Kyushu, and the main facilities listed include MUJI Ginza (Chuo-ku, Tokyo).
entries.c8f33d0898bd630c: This segment sells products and operates food and beverage businesses in Southeast Asia and Oceania. MUJI (SINGAPORE) PRIVATE LTD. and MUJI PHILIPPINES CORP. handle sales and food and beverage sales, and MUJI (MALAYSIA) SDN.BHD., MUJI Retail (Thailand) Co.,Ltd., MUJI RETAIL (AUSTRALIA) PTY LTD, Ryohin-Keikaku Reliance India Private Limited and MUJI RETAIL (VIETNAM) LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY handle sales. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating revenue from external customers was ¥50,105 million (up 28.0% year on year), the segment with the highest growth rate among the four reportable segments. Segment profit was ¥5,584 million (up 21.4%). The company states that, in addition to expanding stores mainly in Vietnam and Malaysia, same-store sales also recovered from the second quarter onward. The segment has 2,505 employees (in addition, an annual average of 459 temporary employees).

entries.e3fc675c76beb8d0: This category covers the business of selling products through stores in Japan and the internet, and the domestic procurement and logistics business and others. The company itself carries out sales and supply, food and beverage sales and camp ground operation, and MUJI HOUSE Co., Ltd. carries out housing sales. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥470,143 million (up 20.9% from the previous year), the largest of the 4 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. Segment profit was ¥52,111 million (up 31.2%). As reasons for the increase in revenue, the company cites stronger product appeal, including skin care and daily consumables, continued marketing using SNS and its own app, and improved operational capability such as store operation and inventory management, and states that existing-store sales stayed on a positive trend throughout the year. The number of employees is 2,845 (plus temporary employees averaging 10,635 over the year).
